note: Every source cited by the physics thread. 'access' says what was actually read: full text fetched, abstract only, or a value quoted second-hand inside another fetched source. Retrieval times are UTC from prior-art/_cmdlog.txt. Identifiers were verified by fetching Crossref metadata (prior-art/raw/cr-*.json); nothing is cited from memory.

sources.citation: Park H, Choi H (2010). Aerodynamic characteristics of flying fish in gliding flight. J Exp Biol 213:3269-3279.
sources.access: full text (Wayback Machine copy of the publisher PDF, prior-art/raw/wb-park-choi-2010.pdf)
sources.found_via: orx discover openalex (oa-ff-aero), orx discover pubmed (pm-exocoet), Europe PMC
sources.method: wind tunnel on five stuffed Cypselurus hiraii specimens at 12 m/s free stream; morphometrics measured directly

sources.citation: Makiguchi Y, Kuramochi K, Iwane S, Kojima T, Naito Y (2013). Take-off performance of flying fish Cypselurus heterurus doederleini measured with miniature acceleration data loggers. Aquat Biol 18:105-111.
sources.method: 13 captive fish with 3-axis accelerometers in a 535 m3 aquarium with sharks; leap speed estimated from tail-beat frequency with Wardle's formula, not measured directly

sources.citation: Davenport J (1994). How and why do flying fish fly? Rev Fish Biol Fish 4:184-214.
sources.access: abstract only (Springer landing page, prior-art/raw/pdf-davenport-1994.html); full text paywalled
sources.found_via: issue #50 starting list; DOI verified in Crossref

sources.citation: Davenport J (1992). Wing-loading, stability and morphometric relationships in flying fish (Exocoetidae) from the north-eastern Atlantic. J Mar Biol Assoc UK 72:25-39.
sources.found_via: cited in Park and Choi 2010 and Makiguchi 2013; found by Crossref bibliographic query

sources.citation: Davenport J (2003). Allometric constraints on stability and maximum size in flying fishes: implications for their evolution. J Fish Biol 62:455-463.
sources.found_via: cited in Makiguchi 2013; Crossref bibliographic query

sources.citation: Fish FE (1990). Wing design and scaling of flying fish with regard to flight performance. J Zool 221:391-403.
sources.access: abstract only (Crossref record, prior-art/raw/cr-fish-1990.json); full text paywalled

sources.citation: Kawachi K, Inada Y, Azuma A (1993). Optimal flight path of flying fish. J Theor Biol 163:145-159.
sources.access: title only (Crossref record); values quoted second-hand from Deng 2019

sources.citation: Deng J, Wang S, Zhang L, Wang Z, Zhang G, Liu Y (2019). Numerical prediction of aerodynamic performance for a flying fish during gliding flight. Bioinspir Biomim 14:046009.
sources.method: CFD; its own numbers are simulation results and are not used as data; its introduction is used for second-hand quotes of Hertel 1966 and Kawachi 1993

sources.citation: Bahlman JW, Swartz SM, Riskin DK, Breuer KS (2013). Glide performance and aerodynamics of non-equilibrium glides in northern flying squirrels (Glaucomys sabrinus). J R Soc Interface 10:20120794.
sources.access: full text (PubMed Central HTML, prior-art/raw/pmc-bahlman-2013.html; also Wayback PDF)
sources.found_via: Europe PMC (epmc-flyingsquirrel-wl); DOI verified in Crossref
sources.method: field videography of 58 glides; reference mass 92.7 g and wing loading 59 N/m2 taken by the authors from published population values (Stafford et al.)

sources.citation: Byrnes G, Lim NT-L, Spence AJ (2008). Take-off and landing kinetics of a free-ranging gliding mammal, the Malayan colugo (Galeopterus variegatus). Proc R Soc B 275:1007-1013.
sources.found_via: Europe PMC (epmc-colugo-wl); DOI verified in Crossref
sources.method: animal-borne 3-axis accelerometers on five free-ranging colugos

sources.citation: Span Efficiency of Flying Animals. Integr Comp Biol (2026), icag077.
sources.access: full text (PubMed Central HTML, prior-art/raw/pmc-span-efficiency-2026.html); its Table 1 is a compilation whose primary sources (Walker et al. 2009; Wolf et al. 2010; Von Busse et al. 2012; Norberg 1970, 1976) were not fetched
sources.method: literature compilation; bird rows were dropped at parse time and never read (Aves holdout). Internal check: for insect rows the tabulated S and m do not reproduce the tabulated WL within a factor of about 5 to 8, so WL for insects is flagged uncertain
